verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is an online business-filing and records service, so outbound event notifications are a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents only web filing, payment, status lookup and document download, with no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The document-status check page is a manual lookup, not a webhook subscription, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
